description: Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie. Coverage: Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zonage réglementaire de l'assainissement des eaux usées; Compte administratif de l'assainissement 2017; Compte administratif de l'assainissement 2016. Formats seen: ODS, JSON, CSV, KML, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
